message: Operator points out severely underutilized worker capacity; do NOT interpret the one Working implementation worker as near-completion. Urgently inspect the actual dependency graph and available Parked/Ready workers. Define/approve and ASSIGN multiple genuinely independent bounded source/test/evidence tasks (with precise leases, baselines, no overlap) that can advance concurrently with Client.Release and current frozen reviews. Prioritize real critical-path progress, not busywork, duplicate tests or artificial blocking; distinguish review-gated slices from source work that can start now. Manager will launch assigned Ready agents. Preserve source review/integration and production cutover gates. Send exact newly eligible task IDs/agents to Manager.
